title: Pricing Schedule — Protected Reserved Price for Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Reservations
content:
**What counts as a lower price.** For Pre-Orders & Back-Orders price protection, a lower price counts only as recorded by a Marlowe & Finch sale. That means a booked order line on the customer's own Online Orders whose booking date is on or after the reservation date. The most recent qualifying booking gives the protected price.

**Protected price.** The protected price is the unit price of the most recent regular-price booking of the reserved SKU itself. The reserved unit price is lowered to it only when it is lower.

**Protection limit and the protected reserved price.** The reserved unit price is never lowered by more than the protection limit, a share of the reserved unit price. The protection limit is 5 percent. The price this protection gives the reservation, its protected reserved price, is the higher of two amounts:

- the protected price;
- the reserved unit price times one minus the protection limit.

It is never above the reserved unit price. It is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. It is the reserved unit price itself when no qualifying booking is lower.

**Inputs**

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Reserved unit price | The reservation record, as it currently stands |
| Reservation date and reserved SKU | The reservation record |
| Bookings of the SKU, with booking date, unit price and price type | The order lines on the customer's Online Orders |

**Worked examples (hypothetical reservations with a reserved unit price of $200.00, reserved 1 June)**

| Most recent regular-price booking of the SKU on or after 1 June | $200.00 times 0.95 | Higher of the two | Protected reserved price |
|---|---|---|---|
| $170.00 on 9 June | $190.00 | $190.00 | $190.00 |
| $195.00 on 9 June | $190.00 | $195.00 | $195.00 |
| $210.00 on 9 June | $190.00 | $210.00 | $200.00, never above the reserved unit price |
| None (the only booking is dated 28 May) | — | — | $200.00 |

**Rounding at the end (hypothetical).** A reserved unit price of $149.99 and a most recent regular-price booking of $120.00 give $149.99 times 0.95, which is $142.4905. That is higher than $120.00, so the protected reserved price is $142.4905, rounded to $142.49.
